ablation.notes: Phase 4I.9: WCT (Whitening and Coloring Transform) replaces AdaIN. Probe B diagnosis: AdaIN cov correction only 2.5%. WCT matches full covariance matrix. Inference-only change (training identical to 4I.7b). Target: break Pareto by improving clip via covariance matching while keeping lpips via lowpass lock.
